brief:
Israeli authorities imposed an international travel ban on Shawan Jabarin, head of the human rights organization Al-Haq, Human Rights Watch reported. The ban took effect November 13, 2026, and restricts the prominent Palestinian rights defender from leaving the occupied West Bank.

The move comes amid what rights groups describe as escalating attacks against Palestinians and civil society organizations across the Occupied Palestinian Territory. Al-Haq has long documented alleged Israeli violations and Palestinian abuses.
dek: Israeli authorities on November 13, 2026, imposed an international travel ban on Shawan Jabarin, the head of Al-Haq, a leading Palestinian human rights organization in the occupied West Bank. The travel ban comes in the context of increasing attacks against Palestinians and civil society groups in the Occupied Palestinian Territory.
title: Israel bars Palestinian rights leader from international travel
